title: Better Basics
description: This modpack is a vanilla Minecraft with mods to enhance your lag to a minimum, add new structures, and make it a better way to play Minecraft. Inspiration from Vanilla Perfected.
body: A perfect modpack for you! Included many adventure and customizable features and mods that help you in the longrun. Some of these mods include Dynamic Lights, Enchantment Books re-covered, Freecam, Inventory Managment, Lightly, Map In Slot, Monsters In The Closet, Mouse Tweaks, Right Click Harvest, ect. This is your go to modpack for adventure and a vannila version of Minecraft that will help you in your times of hardship.
